description_en: Call the `ListTagResources` API to list the tags associated with your applications
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources接口查询应用和标签的对应关系
kebab_example: aliyun sae list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type application --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only `application` is supported
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A query can return a maximum of 50 results. If the number of results exceeds this limit, the response includes a NextToken. To retrieve the next page of results, pass this token in your next request
parameters.help_zh: 一次查询最多返回50条结果，当结果超过50条时，会同时返回一个NextToken，下一次查询使用该NextToken即可查询前50条结果之外的结果
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs, specified as a JSON array of strings. This parameter is required if the Tags parameter is not specified
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。可填写多个资源ID，用英文逗号（,）分隔。当您未输入Tags参数时必填
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The tags used to filter resources. This parameter is required if the ResourceIds parameter is not specified. A tag is a key-value pair.

key: The tag key. The key can be 1 to 128 characters in length.

value: The tag value. The value can be 1 to 128 characters in length.

Tag keys and tag values are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, the operation returns only resources that have all the specified tags.

A tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：
key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。
value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。

区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。

不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tags

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

2xx indicates that the request was successful.

3xx indicates that the request was redirected.

4xx indicates that a client-side error occurred.

5xx indicates that a server-side error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. A query returns a maximum of 50 results. If the results are truncated, you can use this token in a subsequent request to retrieve the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 一次查询最多返回50条结果，当结果超过50条时，会同时返回一个NextToken，下一次查询使用该NextToken即可查询前50条结果之外的结果

TagResources.description_en: The list of tags and their associated resources
TagResources.description_zh: 应用和标签的对应关系

items.description_en: The details of a tag and the resource to which the tag is added

ResourceType.description_en: The type of the resource. The value is fixed as `application`

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is returned only if the request fails.

For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the request.

If the request is successful, success is returned.

If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
查询应用和标签的对应关系是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：查询成功。
false：查询失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of a request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，可用于精确查询调用信息
